_comment: English body for tencent-docs-ai; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by Tencent Docs’ generative capabilities; the model and available features vary by account, edition and region.
axes.runtime: Runs in Tencent Docs’ cloud, with web, client and mini-program entry points; generation happens server-side.
axes.local_files: Can read the current document, spreadsheet, presentation and uploaded attachments; local files must be uploaded. Local files usually need upload or authorised access, so confirm storage, retention and deletion.
axes.background: Writing, spreadsheet formulas and presentation generation are triggered inside the document; there is no general agent that survives shutdown.
axes.tools: Integrated with Tencent Docs documents, sheets, presentations, forms, comments and sharing; collaborates through Tencent ecosystem accounts.
axes.context: Context is mainly the current document and collaborative documents the account can access; cross-team knowledge-base capability is limited.
axes.permissions: Commercial use and data terms follow the Tencent Docs agreement; sharing permissions and export scope are controlled by the owner.
axes.fit: Fits: Chinese document writing, spreadsheet formulas and first-draft presentations. Does not fit: complex data modelling or cross-enterprise knowledge retrieval.
